# PRD: <feature>

## Problem
Who is affected, what hurts today, evidence (tickets, calls, numbers).

## Goal
One sentence. How we know it worked.

## Non-goals
What we deliberately do not do now.

## Users and permissions
Which roles can use it. Tenant rules.

## Requirements
Numbered, testable statements. R1, R2, ...

## Acceptance criteria
Given / when / then per requirement.

## Open questions
Unknowns with an owner. Never guess, list them here.

title: PRD: Invoice CSV export
content:
# PRD: Invoice CSV export

Source: DEMO-110, request from Northwind.

## Problem
Finance teams at our customers rebuild invoice lists by hand in Excel every month end. Northwind asked twice in October. Three other tenants asked support for the same thing.

## Goal
A billing user downloads the invoices they see as a CSV that opens correctly in Excel. Success: month-end support requests about exports drop to zero.

## Non-goals
- XLSX or PDF export.
- Scheduled or emailed exports.
- Exporting other tenants' data, even for admins.

## Users and permissions
- Billing and admin roles can export. Viewers cannot.
- Only invoices of the caller's tenant are ever included.

## Requirements
- R1. `GET /invoices/export` returns `text/csv` with columns: Number, Customer, Amount, Currency, Status, IssuedAt, PaidAt.
- R2. Optional filters: status and issued date range (from, to). Same rules as the invoice list.
- R3. Amounts use a dot as decimal separator, dates are ISO 8601 UTC. File is UTF-8 with BOM so Excel shows accents correctly.
- R4. Up to 10,000 rows per export, streamed, p95 under 2 seconds.
- R5. Each export is written to the audit log with user, tenant, filters and row count.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a billing user of acme, when they export, then only acme invoices are in the file.
- Given a viewer, when they export, then the API returns 403.
- Given a status filter Paid, when exporting, then only Paid invoices are included.
- Given more than 10,000 matching invoices, when exporting, then the API returns 400 with a message to narrow the filters.
- Given any export, then one audit entry is written.
- Given a customer name with accents, when the file is opened in Excel, then it is displayed correctly.

## Open questions
- Should Void invoices be included by default? Owner: Aoife.
- Do we need a button in the Android app in this release? Owner: Ciara.

## Jira tickets
Not created yet.

title: Call notes: Northwind, 3 Nov
content:
# Call notes: Northwind, 3 Nov

Attendees: Aoife (PM), Sean, Northwind finance lead.

- They chase unpaid invoices manually by email, 40+ per month.
- Want automatic reminders: 3 days before due date, on due date, 7 days overdue.
- Some customers must never get reminders (key accounts). Need an opt-out per customer.
- Reminder emails must come from their domain, not ours. Sean thinks this needs DNS setup per tenant.
- They want to see who was reminded and when, ideally on the invoice page.
- Not now: SMS, escalation to collections.
- Due dates do not exist in our invoices yet. Sean: we need to add them first.
